baseline.note: Current production prompt/input, Ollama model defaults, unconstrained output.

json_schema_names.note: Constrain keep-list values to supplied names.

typed_schema.note: Separate keepSkills/keepTools arrays under a dynamic schema.

bit_array_schema.note: Return aligned binary decisions under a fixed-length schema.

opaque_ids_schema.note: Use short stable IDs in catalog and output, then map to canonical names.

semantic_aliases.note: Add compact semantic aliases after opaque/tool-like names.

first_sentence.note: Keep only the first sentence of every description.

no_descriptions.note: Remove descriptions and classify from names alone.

affordance_descriptions.note: Rewrite descriptions into concise can/use-when form.

flat_catalog.note: Mix skills and tools into one labelled candidate list.

tools_first.note: Reverse grouped catalog order so tools precede skills.

shuffled_catalog.note: Shuffle candidate order deterministically per case and seed.

full_history.note: Include older plus recent user and assistant messages.

previous_keep.note: Add prior keep decisions as weak evidence where available.

causal_prompt.note: Frame relevance as causal hindrance if removed.

minimal_prompt.note: Use a shorter direct classification instruction.

next_step_frontier.note: Select only the next action frontier (negative-control hypothesis).
